submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Surgical LOCAL edit of reference1: mountain guardian boy NORTH run frame03. Return the same FULL SQUARE CANVAS with its original transparent borders and character scale. Do not recompose, enlarge, recenter, or redraw a new full-body pose. Reference1 is the exact target; reference2 is the approved bamboo archer NORTH frame03 for rear HEEL construction only; reference3 mountain guardian identity, reference4 N idle for BACK costume and gear only, reference5 approved paint finish.
EDIT MASK IN WORDS: ONLY the one SMALL supporting/precontact boot on screen-RIGHT, below its green jade ankle beads. The other large boot sole facing the viewer belongs to the lifted rear leg and MUST STAY exactly as reference1. Correct the small boot's ambiguous front-toe appearance into a clearly BACK-VIEW brown leather HEEL: a compact near-vertical heel counter/back wall, subtle vertical center back seam and gold heel rim; the toe and forefoot point AWAY into NORTH depth, concealed beyond the lower leg. Keep the thick brown/gold/jade boot design. Do not copy white boots, archer legs, knee height, body shape, bow, or skin from reference2.
STRICT CANVAS LOCK (coordinates are on reference1's normalized1024x1024 canvas): keep top of hair about y61; original whole-subject left/right margins about x161 and x948, do not expand past them. The small edited boot remains horizontally centered around x570, with its contact-bottom exactly y947, never lower. Preserve ALL head, torso, hip, thigh, knee, trouser cuff and ankle heights/positions; change only the visible heel geometry below the ankle. Preserve exact reference1 scale/transparent margins; do not fill more canvas. The staff and shield must retain their full lengths and positions. No leg extension, shortening, stance widening/narrowing or foot sliding.
All upper body pixels and the other boot should remain visually unchanged: anatomical right hand long staff at screen-right, left arm round shield at screen-left, brown ponytail/gold-green armor, solid rear gold medallion and transparent hanging small jade ring hole. Preserve current phase and shoulder/elbow action. No mirrored foot, no image translation, no crop/zoom, no effects/background/shadow/text. One square at least1024 native true RGBA transparent image, same polished painted chibi style.
